messages:
ellie: Heads-up — noticed a perf regression on the 4k+ seq path in prod yesterday. p50 jumped ~18% on a100 pools. Logs point to a different execution path/kerneltag being chosen for long sequences.
dan: Ugh. Is this the autotuner flip or something we shipped in the last runtime change?
ellie: Looks like autotune + a heuristic change. Telemetry lines: `execpath_choice: chosen=matmul_v2_fused reason=arch=a100 seq_len=4096 mem_ratio=0.82 pref_hint=autotune`
sam: Can you paste the raw telemetry block? need to check why the tiling variant wasn't selected.
ellie: pasted snippet from /var/log/redwood/runtime/execpath.log:```
[2026-11-03T21:02:11Z] tid=1432 request_id=8f3a execpath_choice chosen=matmul_v2_fused score=0.72 reason="latency_est<cost_est && mem_pressure_high"
[2026-11-03T21:02:11Z] tid=1432 candidates=[matmul_tiled:score=0.68, matmul_v2_fused:score=0.72, matmul_sparse:score=0.55]
[2026-11-03T21:02:11Z] tid=1432 hw_profile=a100-sxm4 sm=80 sm_util=0.64 mem_ratio=0.82 seq_len=4096 flags=REDWOOD_KERNEL_DEBUG=1]
```

nina: That scoring delta is small. We changed the memory penalty coefficient in autotune last month (PR #4123) — might be tipping ties to fused.
dan: Is fused actually slower at this seq_len historically? Perf profiles from canary showed fused was better under <3k but regressed >4k.
ryan: I dug up a perf-run: `perf_runs/2026-10/fused_vs_tiled_4096.json` shows throughput_fused=9.1 tok/s, throughput_tiled=10.8 tok/s on a100. So yes, fused is worse at 4k.
perf-bot: perf-summary: test=fused_vs_tiled seq=4096 hw=a100 iterations=100 fused_median=110ms tiled_median=92ms delta=+19.6% (regression)
ellie: So autotuner picked fused because memory_pressure heuristic pushed score up. Maybe our mem_ratio threshold is too aggressive for a100.
sam: Can we add a debug env variable that forces scoring reasons to include the estimated memory footprint and token mem per-layer? That would make root cause clearer.
ellie: There is already REDWOOD_KERNEL_DEBUG=1 but it logs only high-level reasons. We can toggle deeper trace with `REDWOOD_EXECPATH_TRACE=2`.
infra-bot: Suggestion: set `REDWOOD_EXECPATH_PREFER_TILED_FOR_SEQ=4096` as a temporary config in a100 pools. This is supported in runtime config flags (no deploy needed) — will push now if you want.
dan: Do it for the next 1h and monitor canary. Also open a rollback PR for the autotune coeff change so we can test both.
nina: I'll revert PR #4123 in a feature branch and run the autotune sweep locally against the 4k workload.
ryan: For the longer term, we should expand telemetry schema to include kernel memory footprint estimate, batching shape (batch x seq), and kv-cache-hit ratio at pick time. Right now we only log mem_ratio which is too coarse.
ellie: Agreed. Quick action items: 1) infra: set REDWOOD_EXECPATH_PREFER_TILED_FOR_SEQ=4096 on a100. 2) nina: run autotune sweep+perf-run with old coeff. 3) sam/ryan: add execpath_trace=2 to a small canary to capture per-layer mem est. 4) perf: run nightly fused_vs_tiled matrix across seq lengths 1k-8k.
sam: I'll add a tiny telemetry schema PR to include mem_est_bytes and batch_shape; low-risk.
dan: Thanks — once the prefixed flag is up let's watch p50 and cpu/gpu mem graphs. :eyes:
ellie: Flag pushed to a100 pools. keeping watch. Will report back in ~30m with initial numbers. :thumbsup:
